other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in stacking meta-features
other_failure_modes.description: When generating meta-features from a base model for stacking, the agent uses in-sample predictions for the training folds instead of out-of-fold predictions. This causes the meta-model to overfit to the base model's training predictions, which are distributed differently than validation/test predictions, leading to severe performance degradation on unseen data.

other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation leakage from global transformations
other_failure_modes.description: Stateful transformations (such as TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoding) are fit on the entire training set before cross-validation. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making CV scores overly optimistic.

summary: The agent sets up a comprehensive pipeline with text processing, feature engineering, and a weighted ensemble. However, it introduces critical target leakage by using in-sample Ridge predictions as a meta-feature for training LightGBM. Additionally, applying TF-IDF and SVD on the full training set before cross-validation leads to data leakage between folds.
